impact: A broad chip reversal despite a benign PPI hits MU, DRAM and SNXX directly and weighs on NBIS ahead of Nvidia's earnings next week.
source: Reuters via Investing.com / Yahoo Finance / 24/7 Wall St.
summary: US stocks opened higher Friday after a softer-than-expected October PPI (+0.3% vs 0.4%), then reversed as chip stocks sold off. At 11:23 a.m. ET Reuters had the S&P 500 down 1.01% at 7,515.49, the Nasdaq down 1.74% at 24,923.79 and the Dow down 0.23%. The Philadelphia Semiconductor index fell about 4.2%, AMD about 10% to $525.77, Broadcom and Intel about 6%, Nvidia 2.9% to $161.41 and Micron about 4% to $766.83, with the 10-year yield back at 5.10%.
title: Chip sell-off deepens: Nasdaq -1.7%, AMD -10%, Nvidia -3%
